validation.developmentCorrections: The startup fixture uses a distinct video ID, retaining split-track media. Remote key pairs share their actual downTime; the first Shorts key waits for the input window to settle. The focused Shorts surface accepts an unmatched first key release when Android consumes its DOWN, deduplicates releases and ignores cancelled releases. Subscription checks accept legitimate initial prefetch while verifying continuation requests. Initial exploratory latency jobs mixed saved resume positions and are excluded from the matched comparison. A constrained-network stall at the initial 150/250 ms buffering experiment led to 250 ms Shorts, 350 ms live and 500 ms regular-video startup thresholds.
